labels.wispy: wispy - fibres, streaks or filaments, like brushed hair
labels.sheet: a continuous sheet or veil with no separate parts
labels.rolls: rows, rolls or a patchwork of separate lumps
labels.tufts: small rounded tufts, each on its own
labels.lens: a smooth almond or lens, sharp-edged
labels.roll_cloud: one long tube lying horizontally, rolling
labels.heaped: heaped like cauliflower, wider than it is tall
labels.towering: towering - distinctly taller than it is wide
labels.ragged: torn, ragged shreds with no definite shape

element_size.question: If it was made of separate lumps, how big was one? Hold your arm out straight and compare.

labels.none: it had no separate lumps - one continuous cloud or sheet
labels.tiny: smaller than your little finger's width
labels.small: between one and three finger widths

shading.question: Did the individual lumps have grey shaded undersides?

opacity.question: What could you see of the sun through it?

labels.transparent: the sun shone through clearly and cast sharp shadows
labels.translucent: the sun showed as a bright patch, as if through frosted glass

sky_cover.question: How much of the sky did it take up?

labels.patches: scattered patches with plenty of blue
labels.most_of_sky: most of the sky, with gaps
labels.whole_sky: the whole sky, edge to edge

labels.flat: a definite flat bottom, all at one level
labels.undefined: no clear underside - it just faded out
labels.not_visible: too high or too uniform to make out a base at all

precipitation.question: Was anything falling out of it?

labels.virga: streaks falling from it that never reached the ground
labels.steady: steady rain or snow, going on and on

halo.question: Was there a ring of light around the sun or moon?

anvil.question: Did the top flatten out and spread sideways, like an anvil?

turrets.question: Did small towers rise from a shared base, like battlements?

hooks.question: Were the filaments hooked or comma-shaped at one end?

mamma.question: Did it have rounded pouches hanging underneath?

depth.question: How tall was it compared to how wide?

labels.none: it was not a heaped cloud - flat or layered
labels.flat: much wider than it was tall
labels.square: about as tall as it was wide
labels.tall: distinctly taller than it was wide

top.question: What was the top of it like?

labels.none: it had no distinct top - flat, layered or wispy
labels.cauliflower: hard and sharp-edged, like a cauliflower
labels.smooth: the sharp edges had gone soft and fuzzy
labels.fibrous: gone streaky and fibrous, often spreading sideways
